title: STARLING MARTE INCEPTION 2021 Topps Baseball Miami Marlins #26 MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a sports trading card featuring Starling Marte of the Miami Marlins. The card is from the 2021 Topps set and is an original Inception parallel/variety. The card number is 26 and it is a 2021 MLB league product. It also has features such as being an insert and having a unique design. The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection.
